issues.location: introduction file ID versus chapter and sibling IDs
issues.finding: This file uses lam/ldf/int while the importing chapter driver uses lam/rep, and sibling files mix ldf, rep and dfl identifiers. A search found a direct lam/ldf/prf reference but no lam/rep/int reference. It is not yet established whether the differing namespace codes are intentional or cause reader-label failures.
issues.proposed_resolution: Retain the source file ID in the target and audit all chapter-level references and resulting labels in a later guarded reader build before changing any identifier.

issues.finding: The source introduces the indexed constant function c_k but then writes c(n)=k without the subscript, leaving c undefined in that example.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use c_k(n)=k in the target and bounded structural-comparison view.

translation_treatment: The target translates Church numerals, total and partial lambda definability and examples; it corrects the constant-function subscript. The mixed chapter/file ID is retained pending a guarded reference audit, and inherited proof gaps remain separate release dependencies.
